primary_estimand: detected visit-event rate conditional on interpretable primary-stream exposure

numerator.rule: count each detected event once within its block; one event_id cannot belong to multiple blocks

denominator.definition: sum of interpretable primary-stream exposure seconds divided by 3600
denominator.censored_time: excluded from the rate denominator and retained separately
denominator.zero_interpretable_exposure: rate is null rather than zero

pooled_reporting.rate: unique detected events across registered blocks / pooled interpretable exposure hours
pooled_reporting.censored_fraction: pooled censored seconds / pooled total seconds; 0 when total seconds is 0

hard_boundaries: frames and windows are not biological visit replicates
censored exposure is never silently relabelled as no-visit exposure
this estimand is not the ecological visit rate over total deployment time
extrapolation to total deployment time requires a separately frozen sampling/missingness model or probability-sample estimator
held-out results cannot change the numerator or denominator
not_frozen_here: independent cluster unit for uncertainty estimation
